schema: hireling plan; tag R. hireling.txt via UI must be read at the hire screen; match 'aura' text

plan.gear: buy best bow, helm, light armor
Insight polearm at clvl 27, Stealth? no; helm+armor from drops
plan.note: hire ASAP at Act 2 (clvl ~17), keep through Normal

plan.aura: Might (Offensive) is the pick, hired at the first Lut Gholein visit in Nightmare: Might exists ONLY in Nightmare rows (V hireling.tsv). Holy Freeze is the caster alternative
plan.gear: Insight polearm, Fortitude/ Chain Mail; Lore helm if shared
plan.note: Offensive Act 2 merc is the default for the Blizzard build

plan.merc: Desert Mercenary (keep the Nightmare hire; revive it)
plan.aura: Might (hired in Nightmare). Hell rows only offer Prayer / Defiance / Blessed Aim (V real 1.14d hireling.tsv): never expect Might from a Hell hire
plan.gear: Infinity (clvl 63) polearm; Andariel's Visage/ Fortitude armor
plan.note: If no merc lives in Hell, hire Defiance. Revive in any act's hireling NPC, Act 4 via Tyrael (S, U live). Revive price min(int(lvl^2/2)*15, 50000)
not recommended for bot: dies from missiles; use Act 2
Optional later; Act 2 Might merc is default for simplicity

hiring: Talk to the hireling NPC; list shows aura per hireling; pick lowest cost for the wanted aura/ level
Give merc gear via UI: inventory panel (open character screen at hireling slot)
reviving: Dead merc: talk to ANY act's hireling NPC (Kashya, Greiz, Asheara, Qual-Kehk; Act 4 via Tyrael, S/U) and pick the resurrect line (U dialog); revive after every player death too; price min(int(lvl^2/2)*15,50000) (S); if gold is short, farm gold first
merc_gear_rules: Wear: best helm, armor, weapon by sockets; don't swap runewords unless runes available
Merc potion belt: none; merc heals with player's healing potion (shift-click) in 1.14: R
